sloka: कथं सा मम सुश्रोणी भीरुभीरुः सती सदा ।भयावहानां घोराणां मध्ये तिष्ठति रक्षसाम् ।। ५.६६.१२ ।।।।
transliteration: kathaṁ sā mama suśroṇī bhīrubhīruḥ satī sadā ।bhayāvahānāṁ ghorāṇāṁ madhye tiṣṭhati rakṣasām ।। 5.66.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "She is always very timid. How can my fairhipped beloved remain in the midst of dreadful and fearsome demons?
